programme.desc: 'S9/E23 - Auctions Arriba!'. Having heard of the recent scores, Dave does not intend to let another great locker get by and Rene attempts some inside information.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S15/E1 - Cruel Summer'. Mother Nature levels the playing field this alligator season, unleashing a host of challenges that push hunters to new limits.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S15/E2 - Double Trouble'. The Swamp is like never before and the hunters are fighting back with radical new strategies. King of the Swamp Troy Landry attempts a grueling double shift, running lines both morning and evening.

programme.title: History's Greatest Picks With Mike...
programme.desc: 'History's Greatest Picks With Mike Wolfe. S1/E1 - Wheelin And Dealin'. From junkyard jalopies to long-lost classics, we explore the rare wheels and automobilia lost to time that yield some really epic deals.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S27/E5 - Lieutenants And Legends'. Mike relives the thrill of stuntman Evel Knievel's legendary career while Robbie and Jersey comb through a stockpile of military relics.

programme.title: Massive Engineering Mistakes
programme.desc: 'S4/E9'. In Sweden, a lucky escape for construction workers as a bridge falls from under them. And in Massachusetts, devastation as a huge high-rise comes crashing down to earth.

programme.title: Massive Engineering Mistakes
programme.desc: 'S4/E10'. What caused one of Italy's most iconic bridges to collapse? In Connecticut, a pioneering new apartment building pancakes to the ground. And in Sydney, Australia, one of the world's most iconic venues divides the critics.

programme.title: Weird Or What? With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S2/E7 - Paranormal Mysteries'. A California woman is terrorized by an invisible attacker who turns her home into a living hell, a New England mother undergoes a violent and demonic transformation.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E13 of 15 - Napoleon's Sabre'. Four bladesmiths are tasked with creating ladder pattern damascus knives from a real ladder. After they salvage their metal the competitors must go step-by-step to create this intricate design.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S6/E14 of 15 - The Falchion'. The odds are against four bladesmiths when they must each forge a chopper in a distinct Damascus pattern. The ladder to success is full of twists struggling to achieve the specific look of each pattern.

programme.title: American Pickers
programme.desc: 'S19/E18 - Wolfes Go West'. In Nebraska, the Wolfe brothers visit a third-generation pioneer village that features a visionary's mighty collection. Packed with planes, trains, automobiles - and everything in between.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E24 - The One With Mary and Allee'. Jarrod and Brandi refuse to be fooled by the allure of showbiz treasures, but Mary and her new friend Allee are targeted on tinseltown.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E25 - Sundown Showdown'. Ivy and Mary start the evening with some not-so-friendly competition. Darrell and Brandon are in their home turf looking for another great locker.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E26 - Father Bids Best'. Darrell and Brandon look to instigate the other buyers and sneak through the melee. Rene brings his father Gunter to the auction, resulting in laughs and profits.

programme.title: Extreme Airport Africa
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Aerial firefighters fly in convoy and conservationists hang from a helicopter.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E13 - Late Season Salvation'. With only two days left in the season, Troy and Pickle chase a legendary line-popping gator nicknamed 'Lucky.' Jacob and Little Willie face off in a high-stakes showdown.

programme.title: Medieval Dead
programme.desc: 'S3/E1 - Crusaders Of Vadum Jacob'. If there's a single period in history that really gets the imagination racing it's the time of the Crusades, which are always the subject of much historical speculation.

programme.title: Medieval Dead
programme.desc: 'S3/E2 - Condottiere: Italy's Dogs Of War'. Medieval Italy was a hotch-potch of City States - among them Venice, Florence and Genoa - which were very, very rich and therefore juicy targets for envious foreign powers.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E9 - Terrors Of The Deep'. For years, there have been reports of creatures living deep beneath the surface of our oceans. The stories include sightings of giant sharks and even razor-toothed mermaids.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E10 - Unlocking The Sixth Sense'. Across cultures, there have been people who claim to have been gifted with powers of the mind. This elusive 'sixth sense' truly defies explanation.

programme.title: Mundial da FIFA Features
programme.desc: 'S26/E18 of 69 - Perfil de Nuno Mendes'. Nuno Mendes, 23 anos, atua como lateral-esquerdo no PSG e na Seleção Portuguesa. Conhecido pela sua velocidade, drible curto e consistência defensiva, é um dos melhores laterais-esquerdos do mundo.

programme.title: Mundial da FIFA Features
programme.desc: 'S26/E19 of 69 - Mundial da FIFA: Guarda-redes'. A última linha de defesa, um homem sozinho. Há quem diga que é preciso ser louco para ser guarda redes, mas ter um grande jogador entre os postes pode fazer toda a diferença.

programme.title: Mundial da FIFA Features
programme.desc: 'S26/E20 of 69 - Mundial da FIFA: Países Pequenos'. Na história dos Mundiais da FIFA, as chamadas seleções mais pequenas também tiveram os seus dias ao sol. Podem não ter levantado o troféu, mas estiveram perto. É delas que aqui falamos.

programme.title: Mundial da FIFA Features
programme.desc: 'S26/E21 of 69 - Mundial da FIFA: Remates de Longe'. Xherdan Shaqiri, da Suíça, abre a nossa lista dos 10 melhores golos de longa distância com o primeiro golo do hat trick que marcou às Honduras em 2014. Golos de cortar a respiração.

programme.title: Mundial da FIFA Features
programme.desc: 'S26/E34 of 69 - FIFA 2026: Idades & Irmãos'. A média de idade das seleções no Mundial 2026 é de aproximadamente 27 anos. O torneio conta com pelo menos 7 pares de irmãos, sendo que quatro jogam por seleções rivais.
